reviews.review:
Buy on sale and not full price!

I can't recommend buying this game full price for what it is. It isn't a bad game but it isn't a good game either. The gameplay can be really fun with friends but it gets boring quickly since there is only a few missions available. The campaign is fun but way too short and the other gamemodes you can play get boring after a few minutes. Also, while playing with friends we stumbled upon a ton of bugs, some forcing us to restart the mission we were doing and making us waste 40 minutes of progress. The optimization isn't great either, all of us had poor FPS on fairly recent PCs and it even happened that the game crashed (possibily for spawning too many units at the same time?). 

With that said, I did enjoy playing with 2 friends and the higher difficulty levels were actually challenging making it fun to try to beat. The fact you could also mix class perks and make builds was awesome, def felt good when you finished a build and could carry your game. The Challenge Cards system is a nice addition to the game, it can spice up your games and make them feel unique (even if you are redoing the same mission). Finally, can't forget about the lore they added to the game, would love to see it expanded!

If you wanna play it, wait for a sale and make sure you have buds to play with.
The game is not very fun. Similar to GTFO without the game actually being fun. Just get GTFO instead.

Honestly with this game there was a lot of waisted potential. There are so many factions in the Alien Universe besides Xenomorphs. In DLCs they could of had players fight all sorts of evils in this Universe from the books and came up with a few extras as well but again they didnt. 
Other then that its a good shooter.
